To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we present a constraint checking based approach for subgraph pattern matchings in large scale metadata (property) graphs.

(1) the constraint checking approach to subgraph pattern matching can be used for both exact and a class (edit distance) of approximate matching; (2) a vertex centric, distributed implementation of this approach can achieve high throughput and low latency for exact pattern matching; and (3) a vertex cent ric, distributed implementation of a constraint checking based approximate matching algorithm can achieve high throughput.

(1) the proposed constraint checking approach is effective for both exact and approximate subgraph pattern matching; (2) it is possible to design distributed, vertex centric, and asynchronous algorithms based on this approach; (3) the proposed algorithms are effective in terms of both scalability and performance; and (4) the proposed algorithms can be used for both exact and a class edit distance based approximate pattern matching.
